§6Copper Plates§f

§aYou'll burn through stacks of these. Better start pressing early.§f

Smelt copper ore into ingots, then press them into §bcopper plates§f at the burner press (plate stamp), assembly machine, or anvil.

Copper plates go into almost everything: machine casings, circuits, preheaters, blast furnaces. They're also half of §bred copper§f, which you'll need for wires and advanced alloy.

You'll be making these constantly from now on. Keep a chest full and your press running. The assembly machine can also press them if you've got one set up.

§ePS:§f No such thing as too many copper plates. You'll thank yourself later when you're not waiting on them.
